picks.what: Ships in the Danube harbor, photograph (ETH Library, Zurich)
picks.why: broadest view of the grain port that made the city; black slide mask and caption strip trimmed

gaps: P0–P3: nothing; P4: only a city plan, a page of 1877 war sketches (mostly Buzău and Ploiești), a troop crossing with no town in sight, and Lacul Sărat resort postcards (outside the city); P6: only a riverside promenade and lake shots with no city in view
notes: The other 1936 Wehrli slides (#7, #8, #10) are a steamer, ox carts and porters on the quay, weaker than #9.
